mapper.select: select count(1) from biz_ticket t left join sys_user a on a.id = t.assignee_id left join sys_user c on c.id = t.creator_id

select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.assignee_id, a.display_name as assignee_name, t.creator_id, c.display_name as creator_name, t.due_date, t.created_at, t.updated_at from biz_ticket t left join sys_user a on a.id = t.assignee_id left join sys_user c on c.id = t.creator_id
order by t.updated_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.assignee_id, a.display_name as assignee_name, t.creator_id, c.display_name as creator_name, t.due_date, t.created_at, t.updated_at from biz_ticket t left join sys_user a on a.id = t.assignee_id left join sys_user c on c.id = t.creator_id where t.id = #{ticketId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into biz_ticket ( id, title, description, status, priority, assignee_id, creator_id, due_date, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{assigneeId}, #{creatorId}, #{dueDate}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update biz_ticket set title = #{title}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, creator_id = #{creatorId}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select asset_id from biz_ticket_asset_rel where ticket_id = #{ticketId} order by asset_id asc

select tl.id, tl.ticket_id, tl.action, tl.operator_id, u.display_name as operator_name, tl.remark, tl.from_status, tl.to_status, tl.created_at from biz_ticket_timeline tl left join sys_user u on u.id = tl.operator_id where tl.ticket_id = #{ticketId} order by tl.created_at desc, tl.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_ticket_timeline ( id, ticket_id, action, operator_id, remark, from_status, to_status, created_at ) values ( #{id}, #{ticketId}, #{action}, #{operatorId}, #{remark}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select cm.id, cm.ticket_id, cm.author_id, u.display_name as author_name, cm.content, cm.created_at from biz_ticket_comment cm left join sys_user u on u.id = cm.author_id where cm.ticket_id = #{ticketId} order by cm.created_at desc, cm.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_ticket_comment ( id, ticket_id, author_id, content, created_at ) values ( #{id}, #{ticketId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: select id, ticket_id, name, url, size, created_at from biz_ticket_attachment where ticket_id = #{ticketId} order by created_at desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_ticket_attachment ( id, ticket_id, name, url, size, created_at ) values ( #{id}, #{ticketId}, #{name}, #{url}, #{size}, #{createdAt} )
